layers.title: Region from orbit
layers.productId: CTX global mosaic, beta01 (Murray Lab, Caltech); listed in NASA Mars Trek as CTX_beta01_uncontrolled_5m_Caltech
layers.acquiredTo: Before February 2018 (USGS SIM 3464 holds a copy of beta01 dated February 2018); exact dates not stated
layers.gridSpacing: About 5 m in the source mosaic; read at about 163 m; about 242 m in our copy at zoom 7
layers.positionAccuracy: Not stated. The service calls the mosaic uncontrolled: its images are not tied to a reference map
layers.processing: Read as 512-pixel tiles from Esri's OnMars CTX service at level 7 (about 163 m a pixel), which are evenly spaced in degrees on the Mars 2000 sphere, then redrawn as Web Mercator tiles for zoom 4 to 7 over a 320 km square centred on the site marker. Pure black pixels are treated as no data.
caveats: For finding your way and seeing the land around the site. Not for planning a walk.
Uncontrolled: not aligned to the site's own map, so ground features may not line up exactly at the edge of the site box.
Black and white: brightness only, not colour.
The service stores it with lossy JPEG compression at 8 bits.
The service does not give the date of each image.
layers.credit: NASA/JPL/MSSS/The Murray Lab, Caltech; tiles served by Esri

layers.processing: Read as 512-pixel tiles from Esri's OnMars CTX service at level 7 (about 163 m a pixel), which are evenly spaced in degrees on the Mars 2000 sphere, then redrawn as Web Mercator tiles for zoom 5 to 8 over a 320 km square centred on the site marker. Pure black pixels are treated as no data.
caveats: For finding your way and seeing the land around the site. Not for planning a walk.
